violations.text: The following was observed: 1) The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine was observed with black debris 2) The non-food contact surfaces were observed with an accumulation of food debris The non-food contact surfaces of the speed rack must be cleaned as often as necessary to prevent the possible contamination of food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

The floors in the prep area are constructed of exposed concrete which is not easily cleanable, or non-absorbent. The materials for indoor floors must be durable, easily cleanable and nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 12/21/2026

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by accumulation of droppings in the office area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 02/21/2024
